verdict.rationale: A keyless runtime probe confirms https://docs.x.ai/llms.txt returns 200 and indexes a full grok-bot/*.md section of 21 pages. Each page is fetchable as raw text/markdown, and the docs-md 404 is explained as a double-.md probe artifact. An agent can therefore be pointed at llms.txt or the markdown docs directly. Missing for 10: no evidenced llms-full.txt or agent-specific usage guidance, and the llms.txt is shared with the vendor's API docs rather than dedicated to Grok Bot.
